description: Read and search the workspace’s audit log (publishing, approvals, team, integrations and workspace actions), newest first. Changes nothing.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

category.description: Filter audit log entries by category. Defaults to all.

limit.description: Maximum audit entries to return (1 to 500). Defaults to 100.

q.description: Optional search query across actor, action, target and detail, up to 100 characters.

name: audit_list
title: Read workspace audit log
